an5.235:1.1: Pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu gihīnaṃ anukampati.
an5.235:1.7: Mahā kho pana bhikkhusaṅgho abhikkanto nānāverajjakā bhikkhū gihīnaṃ upasaṅkamitvā āroceti
an5.235:1.8: ‘mahā kho āvuso bhikkhusaṅgho abhikkanto nānāverajjakā bhikkhū, karotha puññāni, samayo puññāni kātun' ti.
an5.235:1.9: Yaṃ kho pan'assa bhojanaṃ denti lūkhaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, taṃ attanā paribhuñjati, saddhādeyyaṃ na vinipāteti.
an5.235:1.10: Imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato āvāsiko bhikkhu gihīnaṃ anukampatī
